<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at main -->

## What's Changed
* formula: extract commit for goreleaser flags by @cho-m in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24163
* advisory-match: ignore uncomparable sources by @p-linnane in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24169
* Correct Command Line Tools version advice by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24170
* test/formula_spec: mock cached_download to avoid slow test by @cho-m in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24171
* advisory-match: move fixes past shared versions by @p-linnane in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24172
* Recommend Xcode 27 on Apple silicon Tahoe by @p-linnane in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24177
* Infer Xcode 26.x versions from clang builds by @p-linnane in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24178
* Remove comments during automated patch removal by @nandahkrishna in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24164
* Use sandbox env for interactive fetch phase by @Moisan in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24166
* info: show install paths and PATH shadowing with --verbose by @HaraldNordgren in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24168
* Show versions when installing dependencies by @HaraldNordgren in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24179
* Add test-only resources for offline tests by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24173
* Re-sign Mach-O files after relocation fails by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24183
* Interactive fetch shell by @Moisan in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24174
* Stop inferring Xcode versions from clang by @p-linnane in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24185
* Allow skipping cask token conflict audit by @cho-m in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24186
* Require canonical names for formula trust by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24189
* keg_relocate: read files directly instead of shelling out to grep by @alebcay in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24190
* Avoid reusing the exec test's fixture database by @MikeMcQuaid in https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pull/24192


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/compare/7.0.8...7.0.9
